Corona

Chaos Corona provides physically based rendering for architectural and design visualisation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Set up an interior scene

Begin with the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended Corona preview, set up an interior scene; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Balance daylight and materials

Use the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended Corona preview, balance daylight and materials; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Deliver a reviewed render

Start from the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended Corona preview, deliver a reviewed render; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
